topicName: Explain the difference between implicit and explicit cursors.
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the difference between implicit and explicit cursors."},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Cursors are used to manipulate data one row at a time. Implicit cursors are automatically created by Oracle for DML statements, while explicit cursors are declared and managed by the programmer for more complex queries."}]
